t: This is the site of the Tivoli Music Hall, a former theatre on the Strand, opposite the Adelphi Theatre. The Tivoli Theatre of Varieties was built in 1889 to 1890 at a cost of three hundred thousand pounds, on the old Tivoli Beer Garden and Restaurant. The actor Edward O'Connor Terry was part of the consortium that paid for it, and it opened on 24 May 1890. Walter Emden designed it. He was one of the leading English theatre and music hall architects during the building boom between 1885 and 1915.
